question: Does an equipment candidate add a genuinely new medium-native observation/action world or materially reduce repeated Agent production friction enough to justify activation or installation before a specific final work requires it?

installation.note: Two silent installer invocations returned 199 but later produced delayed full installations in Program Files and the user Programs directory. Those duplicate effects were reconciled and removed through their uninstallers; the registry was verified clean. The verified official NSIS payload was also extractable, so one reversible user-local portable instance is the retained authority.

reaper.boundary: REAPER complements rather than replaces FFmpeg or Resolve Fairlight: its retained value is a lightweight scriptable DAW project-state world.

worldGain: realtime convergence rather than offline-only artifact state
learnedBoundaries: Launch Windows GUI professional equipment from a native Windows working directory when it has relative resource lookup.
A workstation process may outlive a Runtime job timeout and therefore needs explicit equipment lifecycle observation.
WSL loopback is not the Windows loopback; keep the controller on authenticated Windows loopback instead of weakening firewall boundaries.
OBS scene mutation can converge asynchronously; immediate post-request reads are not sufficient evidence of final state.
WebSocket remains disabled by default and is restored after bounded Live use.
The current 5.2 runtime uses BLENDER_EEVEE rather than the older BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT enum.
A Blender Python traceback may still leave the process exit code at zero; semantic success requires explicit artifact/state postconditions.
Use -Y when background-opening content so embedded auto-execution remains disabled; the explicit caller-selected --python script remains separate authority.

figma.boundary: No Figma MCP read/write is claimed until the user completes OAuth consent and a real design round is observed.

touchdesigner.boundary: Non-Commercial first use requires a Derivative account/key and has license/resolution constraints. Do not install merely to create an unlicensed dormant binary.

inkscape.boundary: Raw SVG + rsvg-convert already cover deterministic vector delivery; Figma is the higher-information design-native candidate once OAuth succeeds. Reconsider Inkscape only when local vector-native query/edit becomes repeated friction.

result.principle: Tool value is not capability-count. Admit equipment when it exposes a new medium-native world, retains editable state that simpler tools flatten, or materially reduces repeated Agent friction; keep authority, lifecycle and licensing boundaries explicit.
